May 26, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Trb Advisors Lp increased its stake in Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) by 300% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Trb Advisors Lp bought 60,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 80,000 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.18 million, up from 20,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Trb Advisors Lp who had been investing in Johnson & Johnson for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $325.80 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.10% or $0.12 $121.47. About 4.59M shares traded. Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) has risen 1.12% underperformed by 10.43% the S&P500.
Suncoast Equity Management decreased its stake in Facebook Inc Cl A (FB) by 2.92% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Suncoast Equity Management sold 3,365 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 111,984 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $19.76M, down from 115,349 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Suncoast Equity Management who had been investing in Facebook Inc Cl A for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $535.28B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.54% or $1.01 $184.92. About 9.79M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
